name: Kaddu Kofta
steps: Sprinkle grated pumpkin with 3 g salt and leave 10 minutes. Squeeze dry, saving about 100 ml of the released juice to use in the gravy.
Mix squeezed pumpkin with chickpea flour and 2 g salt. Shape into 12 small balls; if soft, rest 5 minutes so flour absorbs moisture.
Shallow-fry the balls in 55 ml hot oil in batches, turning gently until golden and cooked through, about 6–7 minutes. Drain.

In remaining oil, fry onion 7 minutes and ginger-garlic paste 1 minute. Add tomato puree, coriander, chili and remaining salt; cook 9 minutes. Add water and reserved pumpkin juice and simmer 5 minutes.
Finish gravy with garam masala. Arrange pumpkin kofta in a bowl and pour hot gravy around them at serving time; serve with roti.
tips: Squeeze grated pumpkin before mixing the kofta; otherwise the batter needs too much flour and turns dense.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
